about: 20 Questions has no question bank: Henry thinks of the answer. This file holds the categories and the How to play slides.

intro.title: 20 Questions
text: Your teacher is thinking of something.
Ask yes / no questions to find out what it is!

intro.title: Look at the category
text: The board shows what kind of word it is.
Any noun = it could be anything!

intro.title: Every question counts
text: Each question uses one of your questions.

intro.title: Guess it!
text: Think you know? Make a guess!
The winner gets a point for every question left.
